summary: GSK plc filed a routine Form 6-K containing standard PDMR/PCA transaction notifications under UK MAR. Named executives—Lynn Baxter, Julie Brown, David Redfern, Regis Simard and James Strenner—each acquired 12 ordinary shares of 31 pence at £19.3453 on 2026-11-10, split as six partnership and six matching shares under the Company's Share Reward Plan on the London Stock Exchange. No board recommendation, advisor, stake, premium, or strategic transaction is disclosed. This is an ordinary employee share-purchase disclosure, not a special situation; no deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
